categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four main segments: electromagnetic components, power supplies, information and communication products, and optical communication products. These segments encompass manufacturing and sales of transformers, inductors, power modules, radar modules, and communication modules. The company also engages in OEM/ODM production and system integration of electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include design and manufacturing of electromagnetic components such as transformers and inductors, power supply modules with high efficiency and wide input voltage range, and radar technologies (60GHz and 77GHz) for automotive and industrial applications. Production methods involve SMT (Surface Mount Technology), automated assembly, and rigorous testing including environmental and reliability certifications. The company emphasizes R&D in digital control power supplies, modular designs, and compliance with automotive and industrial standards like AEC-Q200 and IATF16949.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the information technology, telecommunications, automotive electronics, industrial automation, and consumer electronics sectors. Major end markets include data centers, cloud computing, AI servers, 5G communication base stations, electric vehicles, industrial IoT, and automotive radar systems. The company serves global OEMs and ODMs, with significant sales to large customers focused on information and communication products and power supplies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major sales markets in Asia and the Americas, particularly Taiwan, China, Vietnam, South Korea, the United States, and Japan. It has manufacturing subsidiaries in China (Shenzhen, Meizhou, Longyan), Vietnam, Indonesia, and sales offices in Hong Kong, Japan, and the USA. The company emphasizes expanding overseas business locations to better serve local customers and distributors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream manufacturing segment of the electronics supply chain, producing key electronic components and power modules. It integrates upstream raw materials like cores, wires, PCBs, and semiconductors sourced from multiple suppliers, and supplies downstream OEMs and system integrators in various industries. The company also engages in system integration and provides customized solutions, positioning itself as a critical component and module supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value-added products with integrated solutions across product lines, enhancing supply chain resilience and cost competitiveness, and deepening relationships with core customers. R&D focuses on automotive-grade passive components, power supplies for AI servers and 5G infrastructure, digital control power modules, and millimeter-wave radar technologies for automotive and industrial applications. The company invests over 6% of revenue in R&D and collaborates with global partners and academic institutions to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of electromagnetic components, power supplies, information communication products, and optical communication modules. The company operates on an OEM/ODM basis, providing customized and standard products to global customers. It also earns income from equity-method investments in subsidiaries and related companies. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the global electronic components and power supply markets, facing competition from other Taiwanese and international manufacturers specializing in transformers, inductors, power modules, and radar technologies. It positions itself as a technology-driven, quality-focused supplier with diversified product lines and strong R&D capabilities. Its competitive advantages include advanced manufacturing processes, certifications, and close customer collaboration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$3.23 billion in the latest fiscal year, a decline of nearly 30% from the prior year due to reduced customer orders and inventory adjustments. It experienced a net loss attributable to the parent company of about NT$55 million. The company maintains assets totaling around NT$4.3 billion and equity of approximately NT$1.95 billion. Despite recent revenue contraction, it continues to invest significantly in R&D and plans to expand production capacity and market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced electronic components and power solutions tailored to customer needs. It differentiates through its comprehensive product portfolio, including automotive-grade components, high-efficiency power supplies for AI and 5G applications, and innovative radar modules. Strong R&D investment, global certifications, supply chain optimization, and customer-centric integrated solutions underpin its value proposition.
